BIKE THIEVES TAKE DOWN

By: Nicky Troll | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A gang of cross border motorcycle thieves have been caught in the act, they’ve been tracked and traced, and now they’re about to get taken down. Carte Blanche exclusively goes a long for the ride.

Unique Selling Point:
CLASSIC CARTE BLANCHE ELEMENTS
- GREAT CCTV FOOTAGE
- ANGRY COLOURFUL CASE STUDIES
- MULTI-LAYERED INVESTIGATION
- CROSS-BORDER SYNDICATE
- EXCLUSIVE TAKE DOWN RAID


Summary:
Welcome to Mzansi – it’s a land of opportunity. Here criminals are resourceful and sly in their efforts to feed black market demands. It’s really simple - if they can move it, they’ll steal it.

And right now, high-end motorcycles are in demand. These thieving gangs operate in the shadows - a slick, cunning crew that knows the streets inside out. Bikes are easy to steal, easy to take apart and easy to sell.

But they’ve caught the eye of team of private security investigators and it’s about to go down.


Further information:
BACKGROUND TO THE STORY
In the early hours of the morning suspect vehicles lurk in suburbs from Vereeninging to the West Rand to Linden – scouting for possible targets. Once they’ve spotted a high-end motorcycle, two speedy thieves get out and get busy. They break in and make off with the bike, loading it on a bakkie, sometimes on a trailer or even in the back of combi.

How do we know this much?
Well, we’ve got footage! And a team of multi-disciplinary private security investigators have pieced this puzzle together over the last six months.

THE SUSPECTS
Mostly Mozambican nationals and about two South Africans. They’ve been identified, and their details have been obtained. These guys are professionals – and the videos prove it.

MEET THE CREW
The SCOUTS
Imagine ghosts in the urban jungle, scouts blend into the background. They scope out the best bikes, noting every weakness in security, every routine of the bike owners. (we have footage of this)

The THIEVES
They crack locks, disable alarms, and vanish in minutes. They’re quick, silent, and lethal with their tools. Masters of their craft. (we have footage of this)

The TRANSPORTERS
Ultimately, the getaway masters. They whisk the stolen bikes into the back of either a bakkie, combi or on a trailer, moving swiftly through the city’s veins to get to their safe house.

THE VEHICLES
At least 13 cars have been linked to the thefts.
• Five combis
• A red VW Polo
• A white Ford Ranger bakkie
• A silver Toyota Aygo
• A silver Hyundai Accent
• A silver Toyota Yaris
• A bronze Mazda 3
• A navy Toyota Hilux
• A white VW Jetta

STOLEN ITEMS
At least 30 police cases have been opened. In some instances the stolen bikes were recovered and cases weren’t opened. The investigators have been working these cases since November / December last year – it works out to at least one bike a week, if not two or three in some weeks.

It’s not just bikes, some trailers have been stolen too – they use these to transport the bikes out of the country.

These thieves have been busy meeting the black market demand!

WHERE DO THEY GO?
The investigators have located a safe house where the bikes and trailers go before being sold off. The bikes are taken out of South Africa to Mozambique, some bikes have been recovered there already. One of the suspect vehicles has been traced doing trips to take bikes to the border. Once the bikes are over the border, they’re long gone and difficult to retrieve.

There is a policeman stationed at the border that deals specifically with crossborder theft – I have spoken to him off the record, we might be able to request an interview and do a whatsapp call or we could possibly use the Insurance Crime guys.

We can expand on how they get the bikes over the border and there was talks of a single location where the bikes go first once in Mozambique, but I still need to confirm this with local sources on the other side.

COOL INVESTIGATION ELEMENT
The team have a surveillance vehicle that they use – it looks like a plumber’s panel van – it’s fitted with cameras and a bit of other tech – they used this to observe the suspects and the safe house.

** we can recreate a scene inside the surveillance vehicle.

THE RAID
A multi-disciplinary team will go in on Thursday. The goal is to catch the thieves red handed and then to hit the safe house/s.

There will be a team of guys tailing the suspects that will alert the rest of the unit to move in once they are in action or have loaded at least one bike.

HOW DO WE DO IT?
We build a narrative around motorbike culture and segway it with the cunning crews using CCTV footage to cast a light on the crime trend. We build the investigation elements in a gritty, CSI type vibe – on the ground surveillance, behind the scenes intelligence, building up to the take down.


WHY DO IT?
This is a classic CB with exclusive footage and a take down. It’s an interesting crime trend with cross border links, elevating the story beyond just a small fry gang stealing a few bikes.

This story has the potential to gritty and action packed.

LET THE CCTV PLAY A FEW SECONDS..

Jenine Woolls and a team of analysts and investigators from Fidelity Services Group are on to them.

MAC: // How organized is this group?

JENINE: // we've, put // the same cars, different scenes, the same people at different scenes, doing the link analysis, the tracking and tracing of the suspects through our technology.

LINK: We're not going to show you this vehicle because we don't want to compromise it. It's just an ordinary van parked in the street doing its thing. But just like in the movies, behind these doors is a whole lot of tech and gadgets. So beware. You might have eyes on you.

FREDDY: // There's three six cameras right around. So you can park this vehicle anywhere. It will be inconspicuous. // And then you can have a good surveillance heading. You mean zoom out and even listen to the guys.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): A gang of cross border motorcycle thieves have been caught in the act, they’ve been tracked and traced, and now they’re about to get taken down. Carte Blanche exclusively goes a long for the ride.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: CLASSIC CARTE BLANCHE ELEMENTS - GREAT CCTV FOOTAGE - ANGRY COLOURFUL CASE STUDIES - MULTI-LAYERED INVESTIGATION - CROSS-BORDER SYNDICATE - EXCLUSIVE TAKE DOWN RAID
metadata.Summary: Welcome to Mzansi – it’s a land of opportunity. Here criminals are resourceful and sly in their efforts to feed black market demands. It’s really simple - if they can move it, they’ll steal it. And right now, high-end motorcycles are in demand. These thieving gangs operate in the shadows - a slick, cunning crew that knows the streets inside out. Bikes are easy to steal, easy to take apart and easy to sell. But they’ve caught the eye of team of private security investigators and it’s about to go down.
metadata.Further information: BACKGROUND TO THE STORY In the early hours of the morning suspect vehicles lurk in suburbs from Vereeninging to the West Rand to Linden – scouting for possible targets. Once they’ve spotted a high-end motorcycle, two speedy thieves get out and get busy. They break in and make off with the bike, loading it on a bakkie, sometimes on a trailer or even in the back of combi. How do we know this much? Well, we’ve got footage! And a team of multi-disciplinary private security investigators have pieced this puzzle together over the last six months. THE SUSPECTS Mostly Mozambican nationals and about two South Africans. They’ve been identified, and their details have been obtained. These guys are professionals – and the videos prove it. MEET THE CREW The SCOUTS Imagine ghosts in the urban jungle, scouts blend into the background. They scope out the best bikes, noting every weakness in security, every routine of the bike owners. (we have footage of this) The THIEVES They crack locks, disable alarms, and vanish in minutes. They’re quick, silent, and lethal with their tools. Masters of their craft. (we have footage of this) The TRANSPORTERS Ultimately, the getaway masters. They whisk the stolen bikes into the back of either a bakkie, combi or on a trailer, moving swiftly through the city’s veins to get to their safe house. THE VEHICLES At least 13 cars have been linked to the thefts. • Five combis • A red VW Polo • A white Ford Ranger bakkie • A silver Toyota Aygo • A silver Hyundai Accent • A silver Toyota Yaris • A bronze Mazda 3 • A navy Toyota Hilux • A white VW Jetta STOLEN ITEMS At least 30 police cases have been opened. In some instances the stolen bikes were recovered and cases weren’t opened. The investigators have been working these cases since November / December last year – it works out to at least one bike a week, if not two or three in some weeks. It’s not just bikes, some trailers have been stolen too – they use these to transport the bikes out of the country. These thieves have been busy meeting the black market demand! WHERE DO THEY GO? The investigators have located a safe house where the bikes and trailers go before being sold off. The bikes are taken out of South Africa to Mozambique, some bikes have been recovered there already. One of the suspect vehicles has been traced doing trips to take bikes to the border. Once the bikes are over the border, they’re long gone and difficult to retrieve. There is a policeman stationed at the border that deals specifically with crossborder theft – I have spoken to him off the record, we might be able to request an interview and do a whatsapp call or we could possibly use the Insurance Crime guys. We can expand on how they get the bikes over the border and there was talks of a single location where the bikes go first once in Mozambique, but I still need to confirm this with local sources on the other side. COOL INVESTIGATION ELEMENT The team have a surveillance vehicle that they use – it looks like a plumber’s panel van – it’s fitted with cameras and a bit of other tech – they used this to observe the suspects and the safe house. ** we can recreate a scene inside the surveillance vehicle. THE RAID A multi-disciplinary team will go in on Thursday. The goal is to catch the thieves red handed and then to hit the safe house/s. There will be a team of guys tailing the suspects that will alert the rest of the unit to move in once they are in action or have loaded at least one bike. HOW DO WE DO IT? We build a narrative around motorbike culture and segway it with the cunning crews using CCTV footage to cast a light on the crime trend. We build the investigation elements in a gritty, CSI type vibe – on the ground surveillance, behind the scenes intelligence, building up to the take down. WHY DO IT? This is a classic CB with exclusive footage and a take down. It’s an interesting crime trend with cross border links, elevating the story beyond just a small fry gang stealing a few bikes. This story has the potential to gritty and action packed.
